principle: Text is non-negotiable but NOT exhaustive. Corpus gives constraints; production gives legibility.

corpus_constraints.rule: never contradicted - kRza, vivarNa, mahAtejas, dIrGabAhu are binding

1988_visual_vocabulary.rule: use for legibility (bandage, beard, crown, throne), never to contradict corpus

production_realism.rule: royal must read as royal - a king is thin, not destitute

failure_modes.over_literal: kRza read as starvation -> beggar look. WRONG: a king can be thin and still royal.
failure_modes.generic_royal: no corpus constraints -> any king. WRONG: loses NAMO's USP.
failure_modes.correct: corpus adjectives set the body; production design sets the status, fabric quality and light.

production: royal maroon silk with full draping
